python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("Files:", z.namelist())
    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))
    # workbook sheet names
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('m:sheets', ns)]
    print("Sheets:", sheets)
    # sheet1
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    sheet_path = rel_map[sheets[0][1]].lstrip('/')
    print("Sheet path:", sheet_path)
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/' + sheet_path))
    for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
        cells = []
        for c in row:
            ref = c.get('r')
            t = c.get('t')
            v = c.find('m:v', ns)
            val = v.text if v is not None else ''
            if t == 's' and val != '':
                val = shared[int(val)]
            cells.append(f"{ref}={val}")
        print(cells)
EOF

    shared = []

        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall(NS+'si'):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(NS+'t')))

    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

        cells = []

            ref = c.get('r'); t = c.get('t')
            v = c.find(NS+'v')
            val = v.text if v is not None else ''
            if t == 's' and val != '':
                val = shared[int(val)]
            elif t == 'str':
                pass
            cells.append(f"{ref}={val}")
        print(cells)
